title: Ukrainian Goose Roast
description: A hearty and flavorful roast goose dish from Ukraine, perfect for special occasions. The crisp skin and juicy meat will impress your guests.
instructions: Rinse the goose and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the goose with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Heat some oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the goose until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the goose to a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for another 30-40 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Baste the goose with cherry sauce during the last 10 minutes of roasting.
Meanwhile, mix breadcrumbs and chopped onion in a bowl.
Once the goose is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before carving.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables and a dollop of cherry sauce.
